notes: Sellers can attach a 3D model to a product: paste the handover .glb link and the app fetches it, runs the eleven checks a try-on needs, and shows exactly which ones it failed
A model that passes is uploaded and held as a draft, so nothing unverified can reach a customer — switching one live is the server's call, and that call goes on next
Sellers can record a last's real measurements on a product — length, width, heel height and the size they were taken from — so fit advice has one honest source instead of a guess
Fit numbers can no longer be saved half-filled or implausible: the form and the database enforce the same limits now
